rules.rawSource: Keep raw source bytes in the authoritative external source root; do not commit raw regulatory files.
rules.substantiveExtractedText: For RIGHTS_REVIEW_REQUIRED or RIGHTS_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_ONLY, keep substantive extracted text, chunks, and rendered derivatives external/private.
rules.promotionBoundary: No source with unresolved rights/storage status is canonical, learner-facing, app-ready, or RAG-ready.
rules.legalConclusion: This policy records a storage-control status and is not a legal determination.
